Power armor, also referred to as powered armor, powered combat infantry armor, and powered infantry armor, is a type of personal infantry suit intended for combat and heavy-labor roles, similar to that of an infantry fighting vehicle. Power armor development first began before the Great War in 2065 by United States defense contractors, including West Tek. Both before and after the war, power armor represents the pinnacle of personal defensive technology, providing its users with excellent energy, ballistic and even radiation protection, as well as drastically increased strength. Organizations such as the Garrahan Mining Company and the Enclave would also later develop their own models of power armor. Power armor is often described as a form of mechanized infantry. In the games, power armor is often a valuable and relatively rare commodity, with only a limited number of available suits populating the game world. Few factions are capable of maintaining or fielding power armor in substantial numbers, fewer still being capable of manufacturing them. Some of the most prominent factions that use power armor are the Brotherhood of Steel and the Enclave. Other groups, such as the NCR, Commonwealth raiders and the Gunners are shown to possess and utilize power armor to a lesser extent.

This script, used for the Weapon repair kit, applies a repair effect to the player’s equipped weapon. On activation, it retrieves the weapon’s current health percentage and increases it based on the player’s repair skill: +10 for Repair ;Most code taken directly from the DLC05AlienEpoxyEffectScript. ;Values have been adjusted slightly (-5 across the board), now includes a +30 bonus for having Repair 100 ;7.6.10 JES float WeapHealth BEGIN ScriptEffectStart ;// get the current health percent and add 25 set WeapHealth to player.getWeaponHealthPerc ;// run through the player's repair skill and augment appropriately IF ( player.getAV Repair = 25 && player.getAV Repair = 50 && player.getAV Repair = 75 && player.getAV Repair = 100 ) set WeapHealth to WeapHealth + 30 ENDIF ;// set the weapons new health percent player.setWeaponHealthPerc WeapHealth END }}

Rivet City is a location and settlement in the Capital Wasteland . Housed within the remains of a pre-War aircraft carrier residing on the shores of the Potomac River, Rivet City is the largest settlement around the area of the former American capital in 2277, hosting such amenities as standing law enforcement, functioning hydroponic gardens, and an active research center. It is one of several locations in Fallout 3 that features dynamic conversations.
